title: Advertising/Public Relations, B.A. — Public Relations Option (Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications)
notes: Public Relations Option, University Park (of two: Advertising, Public Relations -- PR chosen since its full prereq chain (COMM 370->372/420/471->473) resolves with zero data gaps, whereas the Advertising track's COMM 424 capstone needing COMM 421W/422 would need cross-checking). Extended comm_catalog.json (started for Journalism) with COMM 320/370/372/375/420/421W/422/424/471/473. 'COMM 370' lists a '3rd-semester standing' prereq the schema doesn't model directly (same limitation as ABSM/TURF's semester-standing courses) -- placed at the bulletin's own stated position (Semester 2) regardless. 'World Language' (4cr x3, a real placement-dependent sequence with no single fixed course code), 'PSU 9' (First-Year Seminar), 'BA Knowledge Domain'/'BA World Cultures'/'US Cultures' (Smeal breadth requirements), 'COMM elective (from specified list)', and generic 'Elective' pools are modeled generically, same convention as CMPSC's own open pools. Post-parens-fix re-scrape (AND/OR prereq-parsing bug fix) revealed STAT 200's real prereq is MATH 21 (not modeled anywhere in this plan, and MATH wasn't even in departments) — with STAT 200 permanently stuck, COMM 420 (needs STAT 200 or PSYCH 200 or SCM 200, all three of which need MATH 21 either directly or via their own PSYCH 100/MATH 21 chain) was also unschedulable, cascading to COMM 473 (needs COMM 370 AND COMM 420 AND COMM 471, all three required). Added MATH to departments and the real chain explicitly: MATH 3 (Semester 1), MATH 4 (Semester 2), MATH 21 (Semester 3) — same convention as ABSM/ACCTG/ACTSC/LSCPE's identical gap. Adds 9cr beyond the bulletin's own stated total, documented rather than silently absorbed. Bumped max_credits_per_semester to 18 to keep the resulting load realistic given the additions. Cross-checked against the live 2026-27 bulletin's own 'Requirements for the Major' course list (more authoritative than its own 'Suggested Academic Plan' table, which lists COMM 411 and COMM 494 as extra choices for the same 'Additional Courses' pool that the Requirements section itself omits -- same kind of Suggested-Plan-vs-Requirements drift found in JOURN and MDST this session, resolved in favor of the Requirements section every time). Found and fixed 3 real gaps: (1) both 'COMM Elective' slots were fully generic placeholders that could never be credited or recommended a real course -- wired to the Public Relations option's real 'Additional Courses' list (COMM 305/320/373/410/417/418/425/426/427/468/495/496/499) via the engine's match-regex mechanism, same convention as CMPSC's technical-elective slots. (2) 'BA Knowledge Domain — IL Cultures' was labeled but never wired to the engine's IL Gen Ed domain despite its own label naming it -- same class of bug as CMPSC's mislabeled-but-unwired GN slot; wired via gen_ed:'IL'. (3) 'US Cultures' had the identical bug; wired via gen_ed:'US'. Also found COMM 320 (used in this elective list) has a real, previously-unenforced exclusion in its own catalog description ('a student may not receive credit for both COMM 320 and MKTG 422') -- added excludes:['MKTG 422'] to its comm_catalog.json entry so a Marketing double-major or transfer-credit student is never recommended it redundantly.
